enchantment.practical_enchantments.aeria: Removes the mining speed penalty while airborne
enchantment.practical_enchantments.aethe: A mysterious power from the Aether: kills drop twice the loot, and breaking blocks may drop extra God Shards
Deals more damage to airborne targets
enchantment.practical_enchantments.behea: Increases the chance for mobs to drop their heads
enchantment.practical_enchantments.cat_a: The 'cats' have lowered their guard around you
enchantment.practical_enchantments.cat_c: Like a little cat staying by your side~
enchantment.practical_enchantments.demon: Pays emeralds to a demon to avoid death, but with a corresponding punishment...
enchantment.practical_enchantments.destr: Destroys mined blocks and produces experience
enchantment.practical_enchantments.disgu: Mobs corresponding to the head no longer attack you on their own
enchantment.practical_enchantments.execu: Deals more damage to low-health targets
enchantment.practical_enchantments.frenz: Grants a Speed effect after killing an enemy
enchantment.practical_enchantments.gentl: Grants permanent Slow Falling, canceled by sneaking
enchantment.practical_enchantments.heavy: Swing with full force and always land a critical hit
enchantment.practical_enchantments.hide_: Grants the cold protection of leather equipment
enchantment.practical_enchantments.incin: Completely destroys mobs, dropping more experience
enchantment.practical_enchantments.invis: Layers of wind bend light around the blade, hiding it while it strikes twice as hard
enchantment.practical_enchantments.life_: Restores a small amount of health based on the target's actual health lost after hitting
enchantment.practical_enchantments.obsid: Lets you walk across lava, leaving flawed obsidian behind
enchantment.practical_enchantments.penet: Thrown trident attacks deal more damage
enchantment.practical_enchantments.power: Empowers bolts to knock targets back and make them bleed.
enchantment.practical_enchantments.provo: Angers the target; angered targets take much more damage
enchantment.practical_enchantments.smash: Thrown trident attacks can break blocks; higher levels break harder blocks
enchantment.practical_enchantments.soul_: Converts damage about to be dealt into experience
enchantment.practical_enchantments.tf_ni: Deals more damage in the dark
enchantment.practical_enchantments.undyi: Trades dropping all inventory items for one chance to escape death
practical_enchantments.configuration.van: Vanilla Enchantment Tweaks
Change how vanilla enchantments behave. Edits apply at once.
Infinity on Crossbows
Allow Infinity to be applied to crossbows.
Allow Infinity to be applied to crossbows.
Infinity Needs No Arrow
Infinity weapons fire even with no ordinary arrow in the inventory.
Infinity weapons fire even with no ordinary arrow in the inventory.
Infinity for Spectral Arrows
Spectral arrows are not consumed by Infinity weapons, but one still has to be in the inventory.

Power on Crossbows
Allow Power to be applied to crossbows.

Quick Charge on Bows

Any problem with this mod can be reported to the author anywhere you can think of; ideas for new enchantments are always welcome. This notice can be switched off in the MerlinLib configuration screen.
